{{Quote|Greetings and welcome to the heart of the Corellian government. I'm afraid that the Diktat is a busy man and cannot chat, and if he is busy, then I am as well.|Brantlee Spondoon|<ref name="SWG:BS" />}}
'''Brantlee Spondoon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She served as assistant to the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Brantlee Spondoon, the aide to the Diktat, has personally requested your assistance. You've been summoned to go speak with Brantlee. How exciting!|[[Gallura Handerin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HGtII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Help Get the Informant's Information|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Brantlee Spondoon worked in the [[Coronet Capitol|Capitol building]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] as the aide to [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]], the head of state of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. As the assistant to the Diktat, her attributions included the organization of the agenda of the head of state and the approval of visitors requesting audience to the Diktat. Hence, she often used her advantageous position for her own benefit, requesting gifts and favors from such visitors. She thus obtained a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] glosser from the Devaronian merchant [[Midgoss D'labaninaph]] and a container of [[Neonan red cheese]] from the businessman [[Zoda Burb]].<ref name="SWG:BS" />

In the meantime, Brantlee Spondoon acquired a female [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|razor cat]] cub named [[Missy]].<ref name="SWG:BS" /> However, In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the pet escaped her mistress and got away into the wilderness. Spondoon dispatched a spacer who soon brought back the beloved razor cat to her desperate mistress.<ref name="SWG:BS" />

In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Brantlee Spondoon received word from an informant about a plot in motion to discredit the Diktat and his administration. She thus recruited a spacer who had previously worked for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] government with [[Gallura Handerin]]. She tasked the spacer to meet with the informant in a [[Warehouse (Coronet City)|warehouse]] in Coronet. However, when the spacer arrived in the warehouse, the informant was assassinated by a group of criminals made of former members of the [[Corellian Security Force]], the [[Rogue CorSec]]. The spacer tried to recover the informant's hidden datadisk but was unable to do so. The spacer then reported the situation to Spondoon who was very disappointed and worried that the information was lost. Brantlee Spondoon ignored that the spacer was in fact working for CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]].<ref name="SWG:HGtII" /> Jasper and the spacer decided to investigate the Rogue CorSec,<ref name="SWG:FowtRCAD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find out what the Rogue CorSec Are Doing|Corellia}}</ref> and were finally able to foil the plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:RtToaGD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Receive the Thanks of a Grateful Diktat|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Brantlee Spondoon was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Brantlee Spondoon was present in the original release of the game. Like most quest giver NPCs in the earliest versions of the game, she proposed "static quests" to the players. These quests did not provide any experience and just consisted in moving to a random location in order to kill or protect one or several NPCs.<ref name="SWG:BS" /> Brantlee Spondoon's static quests were removed from the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> With this update, Brantlee Spondoon was made one of the main protagonists of a new story arc, i.e., the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:HGtII" /> This questline was later slightly revamped with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]" update, on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the Rogue CorSec story arc was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HGtII" /><ref name="SWG:FowtRCAD" /><ref name="SWG:RtToaGD" />
